chat_export.credential_audit_note: This verifies selected transcript and export integrity without reading provider credentials. Root owns final exact-secret comparison; byte equality alone is not a credential-leak guarantee.

final_comparability.termination_reason_differs: The post-fix run reached observed-token budget in 640950.4102ms; both older runs hit wall-clock budget at about 1700000ms. Same configured budgets do not imply equal number of completed model decisions.

token_budget_audit.budget_semantics: Stop threshold on cumulatively reported prompt+output usage, including cache read/write. A call is permitted before sending using already-reported usage; provider final usage may make that call cross the threshold. This is not a hard pre-request reservation of unknown future tokens.
token_budget_audit.termination_precedence: After usage exceeds threshold, used() marks pending max_tokens; beforeTool rejects additional tool work, and the next authoritative observation finalizes budget_exhausted. The time (1700s) and call-count (80) limits were not reached.

source_evidence.fact: --max-tokens help explicitly says a final call may overshoot.
tryModelCall checks already-reported cumulative usage before each real send.
used accumulates full provider usage, including cache categories, then marks max_tokens pending above threshold.
observe ends the run when observed usage exceeds maxTokens before awarding further milestones.
ModelUsed event feeds reported usage into LiveEvalRun.
Existing cacheTokensCountTowardTheExplicitBudget test confirms cache tokens count; no test run performed for this audit.
